title: Viewer launch standing and Cursor quota order
evidence_scope: Historical production captures prove the earlier four-column page and Cursor order only. Domain tests cover viewer access, retirement, 24-hour recency, freshest-machine reasons and duplicate native tokens. Production verification of per-surface model blockers is pending in levels-surface-reasons-prod.
claim: Levels rows are model/min_effort, with Launchable on chips for machines the viewer may use in operable projects. Blocked models show one reason per supported surface, using the freshest accessible, non-retired machine seen within 24 hours; absent machines are named by surface only. No separate unavailable list appears. Cursor quota order remains two editable monthly-pool rows. This changed behavior must be re-verified on Production after delivery.
